```{r functions}
# Function to calculate wood increment with proper unit conversion
calculate_wood_increment <- function(cwood_data) {
  cwood_data %>%
    arrange(lat, lon, year) %>% 
    group_by(lat, lon) %>%
    mutate(
      cwood_increment = (cWood - lag(cWood)) / (60 * 60 * 24 * 365)  # Convert to per second
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Function to remove outliers based on standard deviation threshold
remove_outliers <- function(data, variable, threshold = OUTLIER_SD_THRESHOLD) {
  data %>%
    group_by(lat, lon) %>%
    mutate(
      avg = mean(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      std = sd(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      .data[[variable]] >= avg - threshold * std,
      .data[[variable]] <= avg + threshold * std
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-avg, -std)
}

# Function to calculate confidence intervals
calculate_ci <- function(data, variable, confidence = CONFIDENCE_LEVEL) {
  z_score <- qnorm((1 + confidence) / 2)

  data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE),
      se_val = sd(.data[[variable]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ci_lower = mean_val - z_score * se_val,
      ci_upper = mean_val + z_score * se_val
    )
}

# Function to fit linear model and extract slope statistics
extract_slope_stats <- function(data, y_var, x_var = "year") {
  fit <- lm(reformulate(x_var, y_var), data = data)
  slope_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients

  list(
    slope = round(coef(fit)[x_var], 3),
    se = round(slope_summary[x_var, "Std. Error"], 3),
    p_value = round(slope_summary[x_var, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)
  )
}
```

```{r data_processing}
# Process data for each model and scenario
process_model_data <- function(model_name) {
  cat("Processing model:", model_name, "\n")

  # Define scenarios
  scenarios <- c("S0", "S1", "S2")
  model_path <- file.path(DATA_PATH, model_name)

  # Read data for all scenarios
  scenario_data <- map(scenarios, function(scenario) {
    gpp_file <- file.path(model_path, paste0("gpp_", scenario, "_site_weighted_yearly_mean.csv"))
    cwood_file <- file.path(model_path, paste0("cWood_", scenario, "_site_weighted_yearly_mean.csv"))

    if (!file.exists(gpp_file) || !file.exists(cwood_file)) {
      warning(paste("Files not found for", model_name, scenario))
      return(NULL)
    }

    # Read and filter data
    gpp_data <- read.csv(gpp_file) %>%
      filter(!is.na(gpp), year > YEAR_START)

    cwood_data <- read.csv(cwood_file) %>%
      filter(!is.na(cWood), year > YEAR_START) %>%
      calculate_wood_increment()

    # Merge datasets
    merged_data <- inner_join(gpp_data, cwood_data, by = c("year", "lat", "lon")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(cwood_increment), cWood != 0)

    # Remove outliers and calculate ratio
    increment_var <- "cwood_increment"
    clean_data <- remove_outliers(merged_data, increment_var) %>%
      mutate(cwood_gpp_ratio = cwood_increment / gpp * 100)

    # Calculate confidence intervals
    ci_data <- calculate_ci(clean_data, "cwood_gpp_ratio")
    names(ci_data) <- paste0(names(ci_data), "_", scenario)
    names(ci_data)[1] <- "year"  # Keep year column name consistent

    return(ci_data)
  })

  # Combine all scenarios
  names(scenario_data) <- scenarios
  combined_data <- reduce(scenario_data, full_join, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)

  # Save processed data
  output_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, paste0(model_name, "_deltacWood-gpp-ratio_processed.csv"))
  write.csv(combined_data, output_file, row.names = FALSE)

  return(combined_data)
}

# Process all models
cat("Processing data for all models...\n")
all_model_data <- map(MODEL_LIST, process_model_data)
names(all_model_data) <- MODEL_LIST

```

```{r visualization}
# Common colors
scenario_cols <- c(S0 = "#3c5488", S1 = "black", S2 = "#00a087")

create_model_plot <- function(df, this_model, idx) {
  # Determine position
  row <- if (idx <= 4) 1 else 2
  col <- ((idx - 1) %% 4) + 1

  # Sample size & subtitle
  sample_n_val <- sample_num %>% filter(model_name == this_model) %>% pull(sample_n)
  subtitle_text <- map_chr(c("S0","S1","S2"), ~ {
    stats <- extract_slope_stats(df, paste0("mean_val_", .x))
    sprintf("%s: slope=%.3f±%.3f, P=%.3f", .x, stats$slope, stats$se, stats$p_value)
  }) %>% paste(collapse = "\n")

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower_S0, ymax = ci_upper_S0, fill = "S0"), alpha = .2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_val_S0, colour = "S0"), size = .8) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower_S1, ymax = ci_upper_S1, fill = "S1"), alpha = .2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_val_S1, colour = "S1"), size = .8) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower_S2, ymax = ci_upper_S2, fill = "S2"), alpha = .2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_val_S2, colour = "S2"), size = .8) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1900,
             y = max(c(df$ci_upper_S0, df$ci_upper_S1, df$ci_upper_S2), na.rm = TRUE),
             label = paste0(this_model, " (n=", sample_n_val, ")"),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = scenario_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_cols) +
    labs(colour = "Scenario", fill = "Scenario", subtitle = subtitle_text) +
    xlim(1900, 2022) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10))

  # Y-axis: keep label only in left column
  if (col == 1) {
    p <- p + ylab(expression(Delta * italic(cWood) ~ "/" ~ italic(GPP) ~ "*" ~ italic("100%")))
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # X-axis: keep label only on bottom row
  if (row == 2) {
    p <- p + xlab("Year")
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  }

  return(p)
}

# Build plots with index
model_plots <- map2(all_model_data, seq_along(all_model_data),
                    ~ create_model_plot(.x, names(all_model_data)[..2], ..2))

# Combine with single legend
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(model_plots, nrow = 2, ncol = 4, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Save
ggsave(file.path(FIGURE_PATH, "deltacWood_gpp_ratio_Sept10.png"),
       combined_plot, width = 13, height = 7, dpi = 1200, units = "in")
```

```{r summary_statistics, eval=FALSE}
# Optional: Generate summary statistics table
summary_stats <- map_dfr(names(all_model_data), function(model_name) {
  data <- all_model_data[[model_name]]
  scenarios <- c("S0", "S1", "S2")

  map_dfr(scenarios, function(s) {
    mean_col <- paste0("mean_val_", s)
    stats <- extract_slope_stats(data, mean_col)

    tibble(
      model = model_name,
      scenario = s,
      slope = stats$slope,
      se = stats$se,
      p_value = stats$p_value,
      significant = stats$p_value < 0.05
    )
  })
})

write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, "slope_statistics_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
